## What is this?

Welcome to Sandstone Sonnets! We're so glad you're here.  

On this page you'll find whimsical poems written about natural features (mostly rock formations) in and around Fruita, Colorado. These are a bit like a scavenger hunt. See if you can find the landscape features these poems describe. There are plenty of hints if you need them.  

## Who is it for?

Locals and visitors, young and old. Kids are especially good at this, so parents: be prepared to pack your imagination!  

For more information about how to use the website, check out the [FAQ](/faq) page.

```{=html}
<script>
// Highlight the trail chip that matches the current filter.
function markActiveTrail() {
  var current = decodeURIComponent(location.hash || "");
  document.querySelectorAll(".trail-picker a").forEach(function (a) {
    var hash = decodeURIComponent(new URL(a.href).hash);
    a.classList.toggle("active", hash === current);
  });
}
window.addEventListener("hashchange", markActiveTrail);
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", markActiveTrail);

// Add a "New" badge to poems published in the last NEW_DAYS days.
var NEW_DAYS = 60;
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  var cutoff = Date.now() - NEW_DAYS * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
  document.querySelectorAll(".quarto-post[data-listing-date-sort]").forEach(function (post) {
    var date = Number(post.getAttribute("data-listing-date-sort"));
    var title = post.querySelector(".listing-title");
    if (date > cutoff && title) {
      var badge = document.createElement("span");
      badge.className = "new-badge";
      badge.textContent = "New";
      title.appendChild(badge);
    }
  });
});
</script>
```
